Experienced Dentists Who Make a Difference

Whether you’re in need of routine general dental services, like tooth-colored fillings, or more complex procedures like SureSmile clear aligners or dental implants, our dental duo can provide nearly everything your smile needs in-house.

page.title: Advanced Dental Technology
page.content:
Advanced Dental Technology Wichita
Delivering More Comfortable & Precise Care
Advancements in dental technology continue to transform the way we deliver care, making treatments more comfortable, precise, and efficient for our patients. From instruments like our digital impression system that eliminates the need for messy molds, to our soft tissue laser that facilitates gentler procedures and faster healing, modern dental technology enhances every aspect of your appointment, from start to finish. Our commitment to using only the most up-to-date equipment and techniques ensures that you receive the highest quality care possible in the most convenient and comfortable manner imaginable.
CT/Cone Beam Scanner
Our CT/cone beam scanner is an advanced imaging instrument that gives Dr. Reusser and Dr. Coltrane a complete, 3D view of your mouth and jaw for more precise and personalized care. This technology goes beyond standard X-rays by capturing detailed images of your bone, teeth, and soft tissues, making it especially useful for planning dental implants, evaluating jaw health, or diagnosing complex dental issues. Better yet, the scan is quick, comfortable, and delivers an incredibly high-quality image. 
Digital Impressions
Digital impressions offer a faster, more comfortable, and highly accurate alternative to traditional impression methods. Instead of messy, uncomfortable trays filled with putty, we use advanced scanning technology to capture precise 3D images of your teeth and gums. These digital models allow us to design crowns, bridges, and other restorations with exceptional accuracy. Plus, the process is quick and completely noninvasive for patients!
Soft Tissue Laser
Our soft tissue laser allows us to perform a variety of dental procedures with greater precision, comfort, and faster healing times. This advanced tool uses a focused beam of light to gently treat the gums, making procedures like gum disease treatment more efficient and far less invasive. Patients also often experience little to no discomfort, minimal bleeding, and quicker recovery compared to traditional methods.
Intraoral Camera
Our intraoral camera allows you to see what we see during your dental exam and during certain treatments, giving you a clearer understanding of your oral health. This small, handheld device captures high-resolution images of your teeth and gums, displaying them in real time on a nearby screen. With this detailed view, we can detect issues like cavities, cracks, or even gum disease early on and then explain treatment options more effectively. This camera not only improves accuracy in diagnosis but also enhances communication, helping you feel more in the loop and confident about your dental care.

page.title: Preventive Dentistry
page.content:
Preventive Dentistry Wichita
The Secret to Maintaining a Problem-Free Smile
Even if you have excellent oral hygiene habits at home, did you know that it still isn’t enough to fully protect your smile and thwart all dental issues? However, routine preventive care ensures that your smile is safe from all threats. That’s why our office puts so much emphasis on these regular checkups; their value is immeasurable! If it’s been more than six months since your last checkup, don’t wait to contact our Wichita office to schedule your next appointment.
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Preventive Dentistry?
Sedation Options Available for Nervous Patients
Patients of All Ages Proudly Welcome
Oral Cancer Screenings with Every Checkup
Dental Checkups & Cleanings
Regular dental checkups and cleanings are essential for maintaining a healthy smile and catching issues before they become serious. During your visit, our team will gently remove plaque and tartar buildup, polish your teeth, and check for signs of cavities and gum disease. We also provide thorough oral cancer screenings, carefully examining your mouth for any abnormalities that may require further attention. These preventive visits not only keep your teeth and gums strong but also support your overall health; plus, you’ll have the opportunity to ask us any questions you have about caring for your smile on your own.
Gum Disease Treatment
Gum disease often begins with plaque and tartar buildup beneath the gum line, leading to inflammation, bleeding, and, if left untreated, potential tooth loss. This means timely treatment is a must, and our office provides effective gum disease treatment using a popular method known as scaling and root planing. Scaling removes harmful bacteria from the tooth surfaces, both above and below the gumline, while planing smooths the roots to help the nearby gums reattach and begin healing. This non-surgical treatment is proven to halt the progression of gum disease, setting your future oral health up for success.
Children’s Dentistry
Our practice is proud to provide gentle, compassionate dental care tailored to children of all ages. From routine checkups and cleanings to preventive treatments like fluoride, mouthguards, and sealants, we work diligently to protect your child’s developing smile and aim to help them establish healthy habits. We also take the time to educate children and parents on proper oral hygiene, making dentistry a little more fun while also building a strong foundation for lifelong oral health.
Fluoride Treatment
Fluoride treatments are simple yet highly effective ways of strengthening your teeth and preventing cavities. Fluoride works by remineralizing weakened enamel, making it more resistant to decay caused by acids and bacteria. At our practice, we provide professional fluoride applications that deliver a higher level of protection than over-the-counter products, especially for patients who are more prone to cavities. The process is also surprisingly quick, painless, and safe for both children and adults.
Dental Sealants
Dental sealants are a highly effective preventive treatment designed to protect especially vulnerable teeth from cavities and decay. Applied as a thin, protective coating to the chewing surfaces of the back teeth, sealants act as a barrier against food particles and bacteria that can get trapped in the deep grooves and crevices of molars. This quick, painless treatment is especially beneficial for children and teens, but adults can also enjoy the long-lasting protection sealants provide.
Athletic Mouthguards/ Sportsguards
Unlike store-bought options, a professionally fitted athletic mouthguard from our office offers superior comfort, durability, and protection, since it’s molded precisely to fit your unique teeth and bite. Whether you play contact sports like hockey or football or engage in other physical activities where accidents can happen, a mouth guard helps prevent broken teeth, jaw injuries, and soft tissue damage. You’d be surprised at how often these handy little appliances are able to help prevent serious dental emergencies!
Nightguards for Bruxism
We offer custom-made nightguards to protect your teeth from the effects of bruxism, or teeth grinding. Many people grind or clench their teeth at night without even realizing it, which can lead to jaw pain, headaches, worn-down enamel, and even cracked teeth. However, a professionally fitted nightguard provides a comfortable barrier between your teeth, reducing strain on your jaw and preventing long-term dental damage. Our team also ensures each guard is tailored to your bite for maximum comfort and protection.

page.title: Restorative Dentistry
page.content:
Restorative Dentistry Wichita
Helping Your Smile Feel and Function at Its Best
Having just one tooth that is damaged, decayed, or otherwise compromised can spell bad news for your oral health—not just presently, but also down the road. This is why it’s always crucial to seek treatment for these sorts of issues, and with our help, every tooth in your smile has the chance to look, feel, and function its absolute best. To learn more about our restorative dental services or to schedule an appointment, don’t wait to contact us today!
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Restorative Dentistry?
Two Dedicated Dentists with Years of Combined Experience
CEREC Same-Day Restorations for Faster Turnaround Times
Insurance-Friendly and Flexible Financing Options Available
Dental Crowns
Dental crowns are a versatile restorative treatment designed to strengthen and protect damaged or decayed teeth while also enhancing their appearance. The crown itself is a custom-made cap that covers the entire tooth, restoring its shape, size, and function. Crowns can also sometimes be used to replace single missing teeth with the help of a dental implant. We offer crowns in a variety of durable, natural-looking materials, including EMAX, porcelain, zirconia, and more, based on your needs. 
CEREC Same-Day Dental Crowns & Restorations
CEREC same-day crowns and restorations allow you to restore your smile in just one visit—completely eliminating the need for temporary crowns or multiple appointments. First, advanced digital imaging technology is used to take precise impressions of your tooth, and then our in-house milling unit crafts the restoration right here in our office. With CEREC, you’re guaranteed a durable, beautiful solution in a quick and convenient manner!
Tooth-Colored Fillings
Tooth colored fillings are a natural-looking solution for repairing cavities and restoring damaged teeth. Made from durable composite resin, which is fully biocompatible, these fillings are carefully matched to the shade of your existing teeth, blending seamlessly for a beautiful, discreet result. Unlike traditional metal fillings, tooth-colored fillings preserve more of your natural tooth structure while also providing both strength and protection. They also tend to be ideal for repairing small to moderate cavities or replacing old, worn fillings.

page.title: Missing Tooth Replacement
page.content:
Missing Teeth Replacement Wichita
Life is Simply Better When You Have a Complete Smile
Going through life with any number of missing teeth will put you at a pretty significant disadvantage; you’ll struggle to bite and chew your food, speaking won’t come as easily, and you might even feel reluctant to smile in public or socialize often. Fortunately, teeth can be replaced—no matter where or when they were lost! To learn more about how our team can help you restore your smile, contact us today and continue reading below. 
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Replacing Missing Teeth?
CEREC Same-Day Restorations Available
Dental Implants Placed Entirely In-House
We Offer Financing Options & Accept Insurance
Dental Bridges
Dental bridges are a reliable and natural-looking way to replace one or more missing teeth in a row, restoring both function and appearance to your smile. A bridge is made up of one or more artificial teeth secured in place by crowns attached to the healthy teeth on either side of the gap. In some cases, they can also be secured with the help of dental implants. This restoration not only improves your ability to chew and speak but also helps maintain proper alignment by preventing neighboring teeth from shifting.
Dentures
Dentures are a time-tested solution for when multiple or all teeth are missing. Custom-made to fit conveniently and securely, dentures help you regain the ability to eat, speak, and smile with confidence. We offer both full and partial dentures, depending on your needs, and design each set to look natural and complement your facial features. Modern dentures are lightweight, durable, and more comfortable than ever, providing a functional and attractive replacement for missing teeth in Wichita.
Dental Implants
Dental implants are a permanent solution for replacing missing teeth and restoring the health and appearance of your smile. An implant consists of a small titanium post that is surgically placed in the jawbone, providing a strong foundation for a custom crown, bridge, or denture. Implants look, feel, and function like natural teeth, allowing you to eat, speak, and smile with unmatched confidence. Better yet, they come with the added benefit of preserving the jawbone and preventing bone tissue deterioration.

page.title: Dental Implants
page.content:
Dental Implants Wichita
A Superior Solution for Restoring Lost Teeth
Dental implants are considered the gold standard of replacing missing teeth, and when you look at all that they can offer, it’s quite easy to see why they’ve earned this reputation! At the R2 Center for Dentistry, we’re excited to be able to complete the entire dental implant process under one roof—meaning that restoring your smile with this superior solution has never been easier. To learn more or to schedule a consultation to see if your smile can benefit from dental implants, contact our Wichita office today.
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Dental Implants?
Entire Dental Implant Process Completed In-House
Dentist with Specialized Dental Implant Training
All-on-4 Implant Dentures Available
What are Dental Implants?
Dental implants are different from other forms of tooth restoration in the sense that they replace an entire missing tooth’s structure, from root to crown. An implant consists of a titanium post that is surgically placed into the jawbone, where it fuses with the bone to create a secure foundation. Once healed, a custom crown, bridge, or denture is attached in order to restore oral function and appearance, and unlike traditional options, these new teeth will receive outstanding support from the implant posts below.
The 4-Step Dental Implant Process
Initial Dental Implant Consultation – The first step of the process is meeting with our team for a consultation to determine if you can receive dental implants. Patients must be in decent oral health and have enough jawbone density to accommodate the implant posts.
Dental Implant Surgery – After we’ve cleared you for dental implants, we can begin planning your procedure. Dr. Reusser can place dental implants right here in our office; it usually takes between 30 minutes and an hour to place a single dental implant, with multi-implant procedures taking longer.
Dental Implant Osseointegration/Abutment – Once the posts are in place, over the next several months, they will heal and fuse with your jawbone, becoming replacement tooth roots that are sturdy enough to support your future replacement teeth. After they’ve healed, you’ll return for a smaller, second procedure to receive your abutments, which connect your implants to your restoration.
Delivery of Dental Implant Restoration(s) – Finally, it’s time to receive your custom-made replacement teeth. Depending on your tooth loss, either a denture, bridge, or crown is attached to the abutments that were placed on top of your posts. After checking that everything looks and feels as it should, you’re all set to enjoy the benefits of your new smile!
Benefits of Dental Implants
Dental implants offer numerous benefits that make them one of the most effective and long-lasting tooth replacement options available. Some key benefits include:
They can prevent additional jawbone deterioration caused by tooth loss.
They restore a patient’s bite force and allow for a more varied diet.
They help to keep any remaining natural teeth properly aligned.
They can replace any number of missing teeth, no matter where they were located.
With the right care, they have the potential to last decades or even a lifetime.

page.title: Cosmetic Dentistry
page.content:
Cosmetic Dentistry Wichita
Achieving Your Dream Smile Has Never Been Easier
Most people agree that when they meet someone new or greet an acquaintance, the very first feature they notice is the person’s smile—meaning that your teeth are quite an important part of you and your personality! That said, if you’re unhappy with your teeth due to aesthetic flaws, know that cosmetic dentistry offers a wider range of solutions capable of helping. If you’re ready to achieve your smile goals, don’t wait to contact our office to set up a consultation. 
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Cosmetic Dentistry?
CEREC Same-Day Restorations Available
In-Office & Take-Home Whitening Options
Flexible Financing Options Available
Veneers
Veneers are a highly versatile cosmetic solution. These thin, custom-made porcelain shells can be bonded to the front of your teeth to correct a variety of concerns, including chips, cracks, stains, gaps, and unevenly shaped teeth. Better yet, veneers are durable, stain-resistant, and crafted to match the color and contour of your natural teeth, giving you a flawless, long-lasting smile. Whether you want to enhance just a few teeth or achieve a complete transformation of your smile, veneers can help!
Metal-Free Restorations
In the past, many types of restorations were created using metal amalgam, which was durable and reliable, but unfortunately, not natural-looking at all due to its silvery/gray color. Thankfully, we can offer a much more aesthetically pleasing solution! Using durable, tooth-colored materials like porcelain, zirconia, and EMAX, we can create restorations that blend in seamlessly with your smile. Metal-free restorations are also biocompatible, safe for patients with metal sensitivities or allergies, and designed to preserve as much of your natural teeth as possible. 
Cosmetic Bonding
Cosmetic bonding is a quick, effective way to enhance your smile by correcting minor imperfections in your teeth. Using a small amount of tooth-colored resin, we can easily repair chips, close small gaps, reshape uneven edges, and even cover up stubborn staining in just one quick visit. The bonding material is carefully sculpted and polished to blend seamlessly with your natural teeth, creating a beautiful, even look. Patients often love this affordable, minimally invasive treatment since it provides immediate improvements without the need for extensive procedures!
SureSmile Clear Aligners
SureSmile clear aligners offer a discreet, comfortable way to straighten your teeth without the need for traditional braces. These custom-made aligners are nearly invisible while being worn and are designed to gradually shift your teeth into proper alignment. Because they’re removable, you can easily maintain your normal brushing, flossing, and eating habits throughout treatment. Plus, SureSmile doesn’t just tackle crooked teeth—it can also assist with bite issues, crowding, and gaps, making it just as capable as metal braces. 
Teeth Whitening
We offer both in-office whitening treatments for fast, dramatic results, as well as take-home whitening kits that come with the added convenience of whitening on your own schedule. Both options use professional-grade whitening solutions that deliver better and longer-lasting results than anything you can purchase yourself at the store or online. Whether you’re preparing for a special occasion or simply want to refresh your smile, our customized whitening treatments can help remove years of stains and discoloration, leaving you with a confident, glowing smile!

page.title: Sedation Dentistry
page.content:
Sedation Dentistry Wichita
Feel Relaxed During Any Dental Treatment
These days, it’s not uncommon to feel a little (or extremely) anxious about visiting the dentist. However, this should never be the reason for putting off dental care—not when you can relax through your appointment with the help of sedation dentistry. Continue reading to learn a little more about how we can use sedation dentistry to make your next dental visit a remarkably positive and stress-free experience, and if you’re ready to schedule an appointment, don’t wait to reach out today!
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Sedation Dentistry?
Modern Dental Office with Patient-Friendly Amenities
In-House Membership Plan & Flexible Financing Options
Compassionate Team That Prioritizes Patient Comfort
Oral Conscious Sedation
Oral conscious sedation is a convenient and effective way to help patients feel calm and relaxed during all kinds of dental procedures. Administered in pill form before your appointment, this method of sedation gently eases anxiety and instills feelings of warmth while keeping you awake and able to respond to our team. The level of sedation is carefully tailored to your needs, ensuring a comfortable experience, even for longer or more complex treatments.
Nitrous Oxide Sedation
Nitrous oxide, also known as “laughing gas,” is a safe and gentle form of sedation that we offer to help our patients feel more relaxed and comfortable during dental treatment. Delivered through a small mask placed over the nose and mixed with oxygen, nitrous oxide works quickly to ease anxiety and create a sense of calm while keeping you fully awake and responsive. Once the mask is removed, the effects wear off almost immediately, allowing you to resume your day without any interruptions.

page.title: Emergency Dentistry
page.content:
Emergency Dentist Wichita
Always Here to Help Your Hurting Smile
Life is full of surprises, and sometimes, they come in the form of an unexpected dental injury. However, as frightening as these situations can sometimes be, it’s important to know how to handle them—your smile is far too important to leave in a hurt state! At R2 Center for Dentistry, we proudly offer same-day emergency dentistry for patients in Wichita with hurt smiles and urgent dental needs. If you or a loved one is in need of prompt dental care, don’t wait to contact our team; we’re here to help!
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Emergency Dentistry?
Sedation Options Available for Anxious Patients
Same-Day Emergency Appointments Available
Dental Insurance-Friendly and Financing Options
How We Treat Dental Emergencies
Since every dental emergency is different, we won’t know exactly how to address yours until you’ve come to our office for your appointment. Once you’ve discovered that you’ve hurt your smile, don’t hesitate to call us and describe what happened; we’ll let you know when you should come in, even if it’s that very same day. In any case, once you’re here, we can quickly begin getting to the bottom of the issue. If you’re dealing with any pain or discomfort, we’ll be sure to address that promptly, too. One of our doctors will quickly perform an emergency examination to note the extent of the damage, and they’ll also ask you about your symptoms and pain level.
Once we know exactly what we’re dealing with, we can administer treatment, schedule any follow-ups if needed, and answer any questions you have about your situation. You won’t leave our office until your pain is gone, your treatment plan is underway, and your concerns are put to rest!
The Most Common Dental Emergencies
Dental emergencies come in all shapes and sizes, and it’s even possible for you to experience one that doesn’t cause you outright pain! Nonetheless, no matter how minor or serious your situation seems, it’s best to err on the side of caution and contact us promptly. page.title: Root Canal Treatment
page.content:
Root Canal Treatment Wichita
A Tried-and-True Solution for Saving Troubled Teeth
Despite anything you’ve maybe heard through the grapevine or seen on television, root canals have a pretty unfair reputation. They’re actually one of the best possible ways of saving a tooth that has succumbed to severe decay, and it’s always going to be a preferable course of action compared to losing the tooth entirely. To learn more about this useful procedure or to schedule an appointment, you can contact our Wichita office today.
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Root Canal Treatment?
Two Dedicated Dentists with Years of Combined Experience
Sedation Dentistry Options for Nervous Patients
Insurance Accepted and Financing Options Available
What Happens During a Root Canal?
Root canals are one of the best ways of saving a seriously compromised tooth, and most patients are surprised at how straightforward and fast the procedure is. It starts with your mouth being numbed, and then, all of the damaged and infected tissue is carefully removed from inside the tooth before it’s cleaned and filled with a biocompatible material to restore its structure. From there, it can be sealed and outfitted with a dental cap to protect it from future harm and allow it to remain within the mouth—and of course, you won’t have to worry about pain any longer!

page.title: Tooth Extractions
page.content:
Tooth Extractions Wichita
Protecting Your Smile’s Future by Removing Troubled Teeth
Every one of your teeth is an important part of your smile, but sometimes, there are circumstances when, for the sake of your future oral wellness, teeth need to be removed. Rest assured, though—tooth extraction is never recommended lightly, and if it’s something that we’ve suggested for you, know that we are committed to ensuring a smooth process from start to finish. To learn more about why tooth extractions may be necessary and how we go about performing this procedure, don’t hesitate to contact our Wichita office.
Why Choose R2 Center for Dentistry for Tooth Extractions?
Numerous Tooth Replacement Options
Sedation Options for Anxious Patients
Same-Day Emergency Appointments
When are Tooth Extractions Necessary?
Tooth extractions are sometimes necessary to protect your overall oral health when a tooth cannot be saved with other treatments, or if it poses a threat to the other teeth. A few common reasons for extraction include:
Severe tooth decay or damage has compromised the tooth beyond repair.
Advanced gum disease is affecting the stability of the tooth.
A tooth has become impacted, meaning it failed to erupt properly.
Teeth need to be removed to make space for orthodontic treatment.
